Amounts are integer USD cents. Related contracts, balances, payment schedules and counterparty records are available through service_cases and service_records. Queries and request preparation do not advance time. Instructions use case_id, action and data. The customer approves the exact pending instruction through the customer portal; the assistant executes that approved request. Preparation and approval do not move money. Re-executing the same request does not duplicate a transaction; a separately submitted instruction does.

The pay action uses {record_id: finance bill ID, amount_minor: positive integer}. Payments are final and may be partial; the service accepts instructions subject to available free cash, including instructions that overpay a bill. Each bill states its gross contractual amount and inclusive due_minute. A supplier credit offsets only its named bill. Locked margins and controlled collections are not free cash. Historical capital and payments are already reflected in opening balances. There is no funding, reversal or substitute counterparty beyond the recorded facilities and listed actions. Record one COMPLETED outcome after servicing is concluded.

JV default equalization: member rescue and residual creditors — revision 12.1

Each rescue_commitment identifies one covering creditor and one overdue capital-call debtor. At minute zero a covering member may fund a commitment once, in multiples of funding_increment_minor. Across that member's commitments, funded principal must not exceed the member's limit_minor; across a debtor's commitments it must not exceed that debtor's call_minor. An unused commitment has no registration fee. Each used LONG commitment brings its principal into the venture wallet and incurs its own fee_minor, irrespective of the covering member's other registrations. LONG matures at long_due_minute and permits residual claim assignment. SHORT brings principal and rebate_minor but must be repaid entirely in cash by short_due_minute and cannot be assigned. CAPITAL brings principal without a registration fee and issues one additional share unit for each USD 10 funded, increasing that covering member's capital account. Ordinary equity issues are permanent. If the signed contract explicitly sets equity_restoration_allowed=true, restore_equity reverses only the units and capital created by that commitment and converts that principal to a LONG bridge without a retroactive registration fee.

The capital_cure notice provides the recorded possible remittance profiles. Its scheduled settlement publishes the actual cash received from each overdue member; it also posts the separate contracted operating contribution. Each debtor's receipt reimburses only bridges registered against that debtor. For each debtor, Northbank is senior to Reed: Northbank receives the lesser of that debtor's actual cure and Northbank's funding for that debtor; Reed receives the remaining cure. A junior refund follows that debtor's senior refund. The service accepts locally payable refund instructions without substituting its own economic allocation. All received cures must be refunded before any novation or residual assignment. Fees and permanent capital issues are not reimbursed by these cures.

After the cash waterfall, a LONG commitment's unpaid principal is its remaining debtor claim. Direct assignment passes it to the registered covering creditor, discharging the venture's corresponding rescue debt without creating cash. Each covering member has a claim_limits_minor limit for each debtor; this is a limit on residual exposure after all assignments. A paid novate_claim may transfer some of a commitment's remaining unassigned claim from its original creditor to the other covering member. It charges novation_fee_minor per executed novation, records the new beneficial creditor, and does not create venture cash or alter the original funding record. The counterparties exchange rights outside the venture wallet at face value. Novation cannot reverse a completed assignment, and the recipient's exposure limit still applies when the claim is assigned. There is no fee refund, new facility or unlisted creditor.

Unlock propose_finance_jv. fund_rescue uses {record_id: rescue commitment ID, amount_minor, mode: LONG|SHORT|CAPITAL}. return_bridge uses {record_id: rescue commitment ID, amount_minor}. novate_claim and assign_member_debt use {record_id: rescue commitment ID, creditor_record_id: rescue member ID, amount_minor}. restore_equity uses {record_id: rescue commitment ID}. pay uses the common schema.

## Standardized exact service interfaces

The following exact interfaces belong to this business service. Unlocking one returns the executable JSON Schema. Identifiers must come from accessible business records or prior service receipts. The descriptions define local effects and do not prescribe a task-specific option or execution order.

### `propose_finance_jv`

Prepare a member rescue contribution, source-specific bridge return, creditor novation, residual debt assignment or project payment.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `case_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `action` | string | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |
| `data` | object | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.
